page: Microsoft Azure E16nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the Endv6 series, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile is built around an Intel x86_64 architecture with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Designed without GPU acceleration, the virtual machine devotes all architectural resources to general compute and memory handling.

Storage architecture combines support for Azure Premium Storage with a bundled 945 GB local NVMe solid-state drive. This onboard disk operates as high-throughput ephemeral storage, providing low access latency for transactional caching and swap partitions. The instance is also provisioned with network-optimized capabilities to facilitate consistent interconnect bandwidth, though external network configurations must account for zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high RAM density and inclusion of bundled NVMe storage reduce the need to attach independent temporary scratch disks, optimizing resource allocation for data-heavy operations. The principal tradeoff lies in the ephemeral nature of local NVMe devices, which necessitate external persistent volumes for permanent state storage. E16nds_v6 is technically suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data mining, and intensive enterprise ETL pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E16nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered with 16 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Delivering an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, it is oriented toward workloads requiring substantial working memory per execution thread. The instance integrates 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency temporary data operations and includes network optimization along with Premium Storage capability. It does not incorporate GPU acceleration. By bundling high-capacity local solid-state storage with dense memory allocation, the configuration achieves balanced cost efficiency for memory-bound systems without needing secondary temporary disks. The E16nds_v6 is primarily suited for production relational database engines, in-memory key-value stores, distributed analytics nodes, and enterprise-grade ETL processes.
